title: Figure 7: Frequency of Object Sightings and Unknown Evaluations by Month, 1947–1952
description: Monthly area/line graph of the "Number of Object Sightings" from 1947 through 1952, with a cross-hatched area for "All object sightings" and a grid-hatched area for "Unknown object sightings". A broken-axis inset at upper right extends the scale to 500 to show the sharp 1952 peak. Caption: "FIGURE 7 FREQUENCY OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS AND UNKNOWN OBJECT EVALUATIONS BY MONTHS, 1947-1952"; drawing C-7485.
